ns2:section.sectionText: *** Except for occasional Tuesday evening exams/quizzes held at 7 pm (CST) the entire course is asynchronous with no mandatory meeting times. *** ACCY 202 WILL OPEN TO ALL MAJORS ON CAMPUS AT 10 AM ON JULY 26 IF SPACE IS AVAILABLE. Accountancy course prerequisites are strictly enforced. The Accounting Department will not allow students to advance in the accounting curriculum if they have not met the required prerequisite for previous accountancy courses taken.
